**Subject: Order TH-48217 – not received; replacement or full refund required by 13 November**

Dear Tiny Hands Edu Supplies Customer Service,

I am writing about order **TH-48217**, placed on **21 October** and paid for by card. The total was **R1,640, including the R95 delivery fee**.

Your tracking information says the order was delivered on **Tuesday 3 November at 11:42** and signed for by **“M. Adams”**. However, the order has not arrived at **Bergview Pre-Primary in Plumstead**, and the delivery address on my order was correct.

There is nobody at the school named Adams. Our gate guard, Uncle Faizel, keeps a written record of every delivery received, and there is no entry for this parcel on 3 November. None of the items have been received by me or by anyone else at the school.

The missing order includes six tubs of finger paint, four bags of playdough, 200 paper plates, googly eyes, glitter glue and two rolls of brown paper.

I emailed you on **4 November and again on 6 November**. Both times, I received the same copy-and-paste response: “we have escalated your query to our courier partner.” I then phoned and spent **38 minutes on hold**, only to be told that nothing could be done until the courier completed its investigation, which could take another ten working days.

I am sorry, but that is not an acceptable resolution. My contract is with **Tiny Hands Edu Supplies**, not with the courier. I paid you, I did not choose the courier, and it should not now be my responsibility to chase them or carry the cost while your investigation drags on.

This is also causing a real problem in my classroom. I bought these materials with my own money for my class, and the children have already prepared their mask patterns. I have spent a week telling them that the paint is “coming soon”. We also need these supplies to make props for our **end-of-year concert on 27 November**. On a teacher’s salary, being out of pocket by R1,640 is not something I can simply absorb.

I have ordered from Tiny Hands three times before without any problems, which is why this experience has been so disappointing. I expected much better from a company supplying educational materials.

I now need a definite resolution, not another message telling me that my query has been escalated. Please either:

1. **Resend the complete order at no additional cost**, with delivery arranged in time for me to prepare for the concert; or  
2. **Refund the full R1,640 to my original payment card, including the R95 delivery fee.**

Please confirm which option you are actioning and provide either replacement tracking details or confirmation of the refund **by Friday 13 November**.

If I do not receive a substantive response and resolution by then, I will have no choice but to dispute the payment with my bank and leave an honest review of my experience. I would much prefer to resolve this directly with you.

Please have someone reply after actually reading the details above, rather than sending another standard template.

Kind regards,  
**[Your name]**  
Bergview Pre-Primary, Plumstead  
**[Contact number]**
